project.name: Mandiri Sejahtera Inventory Management
project.emotional_goal: tenang, presisi, dapat dipercaya, siap bertindak
project.storage_note: Excel adalah sumber data utama pada versi pertama; UI harus jujur memberi label sinkronisasi/import/export bila backend belum real-time.

discovery.content_strategy: Gunakan Bahasa Indonesia yang ringkas dan operasional. Utamakan pengecualian: stok menipis, stok kosong, penjualan terbaru, margin rendah.
visual_fusion: industrial wayfinding untuk status dan label
discovery.layout_principle: F-pattern dengan North Star metric di kiri atas dan tabel tindakan di bagian bawah; tidak memakai centered app container.

descriptors: KPI tiles with delta and sparkline

research.applied_learning: Adopt the actionable hierarchy and exception-first tables, but differentiate through warm paper surfaces, industrial orange as function-only accent, and visible ledger-like movement chronology.

heading.usage: page titles, section headers, KPI values

rules: do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for headings

colors.archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST with warm industrial paper twist
colors.usage: 95% neutral; orange only for primary actions and selected states; green/amber/red only for stock meaning; no full-screen gradients.
colors.contrast: Verify normal text at 4.5:1 and large text at 3:1; use ink on light surfaces and white on primary buttons. Never use pure #000000 or #808080.

visual_enhancers.surface: Flat solid warm surfaces with 1px borders; no glass over dense data. Use a subtle CSS grain/noise texture only in page background.
decoration: small corner registration marks on report headers
vertical orange index bar for active navigation
ledger-style dotted separators in movement timeline

rules: Use raw div/section layout around Shadcn primitives; customize radius to 6-8px.
Do not use native select/date input for advanced interactions; use Select and Calendar.
Every border container requires p-6 or p-8 internal padding.

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6 items-start
grids.tables: w-full with dense row rhythm, sticky header, horizontal overflow on mobile
grids.forms: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6; primary submit aligned left, summary aligned right on desktop
grids.mobile: sidebar becomes Sheet; tables retain key columns and allow horizontal scroll; images are not used.

layouts.app_shell: desktop-first: fixed-width sidebar with solid background and border-right, main content with px-6 md:px-8 lg:px-12 and generous py-8; header has opaque surface, z-50, and bottom border.
dashboard_story: morning status: omzet, nilai stok, low stock, gross margin
diagnosis: revenue trend and stock alerts
action: recent movements and quick actions
layouts.products: toolbar with global search, filter, export; table-first catalog; create/edit in Dialog or Sheet.
layouts.receiving_sales: transaction form on left and calculated document summary on right; stock validation before confirmation.
layouts.reports: date range/filter toolbar, summary strip, chart/table pairing, export affordance.

motion.entrance: staggered opacity and translate-y-2 for dashboard modules, 160-240ms
motion.interaction: buttons transition-colors and transform separately; row hover changes background and left index rule; KPI values count only when meaningful
motion.loading: Skeleton matching table/widget geometry; never layout-shift
motion.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables entrance transforms and uses instant opacity/state changes
motion.forbidden: transition-all; gratuitous parallax in data-heavy views

requirements: keyboard reachable sidebar, search, forms, tables, dialogs
visible high-contrast focus ring using focus color
status colors paired with text/icon, never color alone
table headers and sort state exposed
errors shown adjacent to fields and in live region
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements require data-testid in kebab-case, e.g. dashboard-revenue-kpi, global-sku-search-input, product-create-button, sales-submit-button, stock-alert-row, report-export-button.
accessibility.header: Visible desktop navigation: brand, Dashboard, Produk, Barang Masuk, Penjualan, Stock Movement, Laporan, plus primary CTA. Mobile uses Sheet but desktop links remain visible.
accessibility.surfaces: Never use fully transparent header, overlay, popover, or dropdown background.

media.policy: No imagery is needed for this operational dashboard. Do not add placeholder image URLs. Use CSS texture and data visualization instead.
media.icons: Use lucide-react already present or Phosphor if installed; never use AI-assistant emoji characters.

3d_libraries.reason: Inventory operations require scanability and accuracy, not immersion; use Recharts/Shadcn charts for simple analytics.

excel: preserve movement audit rows for receipt, sale, adjustment
calculations: prevent confirmation when quantity exceeds stock
data_and_behavior.search: Global search supports SKU, barcode, product name, brand; show keyboard shortcut and result type; use debounce and empty/error states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize functional flows over visual decoration; every create/edit/receive/sale/search/export interaction must work or clearly surface its unavailable state.
Use existing Shadcn primitives from /app/frontend/src/components/ui and customize them rather than rebuilding accessible interactions.
Keep the interface cardless or lightly carded with 6-8px radii, visible borders, generous spacing, and no centered App text alignment.
Use real data wiring where available. If an API or Excel integration is not connected, label it MOCKED and make the limitation visible rather than pretending success.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Mobile-first responsive behavior with desktop-first warehouse density.
Give hover, active, focus, loading, empty, success, and error states to every interactive flow.
Use negative space and asymmetry to create hierarchy, not uniform equal cards.
Keep operational copy concise and in Bahasa Indonesia.
Customize scrollbar without adding a gutter.
Use h-full only when grid siblings need aligned bottoms; otherwise align-items-start.
Never obscure content with overlays; maintain contrast and focus management.
